history.summary: Kali Mandir at Belbanwa, Motihari (Bihar 845401), a local Hindu shrine to Goddess Kali, rated 4.9/13 on a local directory. Identity is cross-corroborated: the phone +91 91232 80061 appears on both the directory listing and the map POI at 26.652192, 84.91407. No founding date, dynasty, or founder is documented in any source consulted.

name: Kali Mandir
town_description: Motihari is the headquarters of East Champaran district in northern Bihar. The town is best known as the birthplace of writer George Orwell (1903) and sits on the East-West Corridor (NH-27) near the Nepal border.

travel.airport: Darbhanga Airport (~140 km) or Patna (~170 km); distances approximate
travel.railway: Bapudham Motihari station, on the Barauni-Gorakhpur line, in the town
travel.road: NH-27 (East-West Corridor) passes through Motihari; local auto-rickshaws and taxis in town

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Kali Puja (Deepavali) is the busiest period
visitor_information.opening_hours: Hours not documented in sources (verify before visiting)
